text.p: Sano Corp said on Monday it did not plan to proceed with its proposed common stock offering because ot the recent drop in its stock price.
Sano, which develops controlled drug release delivery systems, said its board of directors was unwilling to continue with the follow-on offering at the current share price.
In October, Sano filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for a 2.15 million share offering.
Sano shares were trading at 17-3/4, up 1-3/4 from the close but off a year high of 21-3/4.
But Sano President Reginald Hardy said: "Our cash position remains strong and we intend to continue to move our pipeline of products forward."
